== Additions & Changes ==
* [[Oblivion]] was replaced by the [[Overseer]] for this event, causing [[M-60]] and [[M-60i]] to have no marks on lockers (Reverted)
* [[Shadow Challenge]] was made more common, being 1/333 instead of 1/666 (Reverted)
* [[SHA-4]], [[SHA-7]], [[SHA-22]], [[SHA-150]], and [[LAPSE-1]] were added
* [[E-10]] and [[E-60]] were set free, being able to invade [[Section A]], [[Section D]], and [[Section M]] at a 1/5000 chance (Reverted)
* All Entities from the [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]] have uncommon chance to invade your run (Reverted)
<br><br><br><br><br><br><br>
